title: Effect of the lignin type on the gas/UV barrier properties of lignin–polyethyleneimine based composite films
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8119-8124
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07628E, Paper

Asuka Yanagawa, Asami Suzuki, Anri Watanabe, Takashi Makino, Yuichiro Otsuka, Kazuhiro Shikinaka
In this work, the film forming abilities, gas barrier properties, and ultraviolet (UV) barrier properties of composite films composed of lignin derivatives and polyethyleneimine (PEI) were investigated.
